name: constraints
note: css-position-3 §3.6 constraint pass at scroll 0 (probe-verified): top: 200px shifts the box down from flow y=0 to y=200; left: 50px on a full-width box yields no shift because the containing-block clamp cancels it (the 400px box cannot move inside a 400px content box); top: 500px inside a 60px-tall parent clamps to the parent's bottom minus the box height (y=100); bottom: 5px at flow y=120 holds (no violation against the 400px scrollport); a sticky inside an overflow scroll container shifts within the scroller's scrollport (flow 155 -> 185 with top: 30px).
